capabilities: Embed attachments automatically as Wiki-embeds according to configurable rules
Convert pasted YouTube URLs into embedded players
Preview and bulk-convert links in a note or the whole vault
Create Markdown or Wiki links to files and folders outside the vault and open them via the OS
disambiguation: Not a link-graph or backlink tool; it formats links into embeds as you type and links to files outside the vault.
extras: Desktop-only (no mobile support). Formerly distributed under the plugin ID linker4obsidian, with a migration guide for existing users. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README warns users to back up their vault before bulk conversion.
problem: Obsidian inserts links in one fixed form, so users must manually convert links to embeds and cannot easily link to files outside the vault.

relations.evidence: the plugin ID changed from linker4obsidian to linker

summary: Link plugin that auto-embeds attachments and YouTube URLs as Wiki-embeds, normalizes new links, and creates links to files outside the vault.
